name: The race garage (H, `garage`; game/garage.js): on lab_race in warmup H opens it and game input stops (W does not move alice), H closes it; on the grid it opens over the countdown and GO closes it by itself; once the race is live H opens it again: a pit stop (race-pitstop), H out of it and back in the car. Before GO it is presentation only: the server keeps the wish ({t:"pit"}) and drops it at GO

alice.exec: admin_login x; mp_warmup_time 0; mp_round_restart_delay 2; mp_race_laps 1; mp_race_races 1; mp_respawn 0

alice.garageCall: press B for the garage: buy and change your car

alice.garageParts: front Linter Beam | rear Breaking Changes | charges stock | tank stock | plating stock | engine stock | tyres stock
